questions.q: Could Jesus fulfilling so many prophecies really be just coincidence?
questions.answer: It's hard to call it chance when there are about 300 of them, some very specific, like being born in Bethlehem. It's like being told someone's exact flight and shown their photo.

questions.q: What hard question about Jesus or the Bible have you been holding back?
questions.answer: One example: "Weren't some prophecies taken out of context?" Any honest question is welcome; we can write it down and research it together.

questions.q: Why was a spiritual kingdom so hard to accept for people expecting a ruler?
questions.answer: They expected a political and military ruler to end foreign rule and make Israel powerful again, so a Messiah with a spiritual kingdom turned their whole worldview upside down.
